stem: A Massachusetts pharmacy is preparing staff for the Board-approved pharmacy technician assessment examination. Which knowledge areas does the regulation require the examination to cover? Select all that apply.

choices.text: Laws and regulations regarding the practice of pharmacy and patient confidentiality.
The duties and responsibilities of a pharmacy technician in relationship to other pharmacy personnel.
Sterile compounding gowning procedures and aseptic technique.
Identification of drugs, dosages, routes of administration and storage requirements.

explanation.core_reasoning: 247 CMR 8.02(5) lists the knowledge areas a Board-approved examination shall cover: practice settings; the duties and responsibilities of a pharmacy technician in relationship to other pharmacy personnel; laws and regulations regarding the practice of pharmacy and patient confidentiality; medical abbreviations and symbols; common dosage calculations; and identification of drugs, dosages, routes of administration and storage requirements. Sterile compounding technique is not among them.

choice_analysis.A: Correct: law and confidentiality is a named area.
choice_analysis.B: Correct: relationship to other pharmacy personnel is a named area.
choice_analysis.C: Sterile compounding technique is not among the listed examination areas.
choice_analysis.D: Correct: medical abbreviations and symbols is a named area.
choice_analysis.E: Correct: drug, dosage, route and storage identification is a named area.

related_facts: Practice settings and common dosage calculations are the two remaining listed areas.
explanation.mpje_trap: The list is specific, so a plausible pharmacy topic can still fall outside the prescribed examination areas.

reasoning_steps: Recall that the examination content is prescribed rather than open
Match each proposed area against the enumerated list
Exclude areas that belong to other credentialing pathways
